caption: The drawing consists of a piece of light-colored, possibly white fabric, featuring various embroidered floral and abstract shapes. Dominating the composition is a large, scalloped shape outlined in dark blue thread near the lower left, accented with smaller details in red, beige, and blue. Several stylized flowers, predominantly in shades of pink and red with white centers and light yellow outlines, are dispersed throughout the upper and center portions of the fabric. Slender, curved lines in blue and dark thread form stems and branches connecting the flowers. Additional embroidered elements include smaller, fragmentary shapes such as leaves in blue-green, brown, and yellow tones, as well as semi-circular forms in blue and red. The arrangement appears loosely scattered across the fabric, with negative space of the light material visible between the embroidered elements.
title: Petticoat (Detail)
